answer: Hardware-rooted attestation resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to present a vendor-certified enclave quote binding its key to an epoch nonce and a device-unique endorsement key. Because valid quotes depend on fused silicon secrets, attackers incur the capital cost of distinct physical processors per identity. However, relying on chipmakers leaves an older architecture an exploitable relic once keys leak, while shutting out bare sensors on a jetty or meadow.
